R Packages

Reference documentation and vignettes for ten actively maintained R packages covering regression diagnostics, customer segmentation, descriptive statistics and inference.

Ten packages, all on CRAN, all documented, all actively maintained. Each was written while teaching at Rsquared Academy and shared in the hope that others find them useful.

The goal is software which is user friendly, light weight, well tested and well documented. Major bugs get fixed quickly; feature requests are considered but not promised.

Full descriptions and vignettes: pkgs.rsquaredacademy.com.

Regression and modelling

CRAN GitHub Docs

Flagship

olsrr

Tools for building linear regression models.

Diagnostics, variable selection and influence measures for a fitted lm.

What’s inside
  • Comprehensive Regression Output
  • Variable Selection Procedures
  • Heteroskedasticity Tests
  • Collinearity Diagnostics
  • Model Fit Assessment
  • Measures of Influence
  • Residual Diagnostics

CRAN GitHub Docs

Flagship

blorr

Tools for building binary logistic regression models.

Model fit, validation and collinearity for a fitted glm with a binary outcome.

What’s inside
  • Bivariate Analysis
  • Model Fit Statistics
  • Model Validation
  • Variable Selection
  • Residual Diagnostics
  • Collinearity Diagnostics
  • Visualization
